task_name: Emberline - Food channel thumbnail and motion package
client_brief:
Emberline needs the promo package for tomorrow's programme, and this time we are cutting it for the way people actually watch us: short, in the feed, with the sound off. Do not build the promo around the host's spoken introduction. Carry the whole message in on screen text over the instrumental bed we supply, keep the host warm and present, keep the gratin appetising, and follow the approved rundown order so the viewer understands what is on the programme. We still want a system the team can reach again tomorrow without every episode looking identical.

Deliverables
1. Food-show programme promo: 1 named export, 16:9, 12 to 15 seconds, instrumental bed only, no speech. The shot order follows the approved rundown, opening on the market and closing on the endboard, and the show name, the dish name and the strap line appear as on screen text.
2. Food-show vertical promo: 1 named export, 9:16, 6 to 8 seconds, instrumental bed only, no speech. Its shots follow the approved rundown order, the show name and the strap line appear as on screen text, the featured dish stays recognisable and every word of text sits inside the frame.
3. Food-show thumbnail: 1 named export. The show name “Emberline” is readable at full export size, the thumbnail carries the Emberline on-air bug, and the dish of the day stands on the house colour, cut from the supplied hero photograph of the gratin.
4. Programme segment card: 9 named exports, one per segment row of emberline_cards.csv, each carrying that row's segment number, segment name, approximate time, card note and strap line, with the time written the same way on every card. If the record names a supplied picture, that picture appears on the card, otherwise the card contains no invented image.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.
- Video delivery means a playable MP4, not a storyboard, still montage PDF or editing log. Every film in this package is silent or carries the supplied instrumental bed only. There is no narration, no voice over and no spoken claim: the message is carried by on screen text that you set.
- Every supplied clip runs about five seconds. Each film must cut at least three distinct supplied shots, and no film may be padded by looping, freezing or slowing a single clip to reach its runtime.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: Daily food and craft television show on a regional daytime slot, with promos cut for the short video feeds and a same day turnaround.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: On air since 2018, produced in Providence, Rhode Island. A small daily production crew that shoots in the morning, cuts in the afternoon and posts the promo before anyone leaves.
brand_identity.about: Emberline is a bright, friendly daily food and craft show built around one host, a sunny studio kitchen and an accessible dish or make each day. It is free to watch and mainstream in the best sense: warm, unfussy and appetising. Because the promo ships every single day, the brand lives or dies on a look that can be reached again tomorrow by whoever is at the desk.
brand_identity.audience: Mainstream daytime viewers skewing thirty five to sixty five, watching on a mid range television and on their phones. The show is free and the products featured run ten to thirty dollars.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Regional daytime, free to watch, everyday products. The look must be lively, clean and appetising, never moody, filmic or corporate, and never a two hundred dollar tasting menu with deep shadows and fine type. Hard broadcast punch is the other failure: it stops the food looking edible.

brand_identity.typography: Emberline runs Optima nova for display and Omnes for text. Step 01, Display / H1, is Optima nova Demi at 150 px on 165 px leading, tracking -0.01 em, for example a title reading Weeknight gratin, on the table in an hour, with its first letter at 262 px, 1.75 times the cap height, on the shared baseline and hung left outside the block. Step 02, Subheading / H2, is Optima nova Demi at 96 px on 106 px leading, tracking -0.005 em, for the endboard and show name, with spoken straps in Omnes Semibold 600 at 84 px on 100 px. Step 03, Body, is Omnes Regular 400 at 36 px on 48 px leading, tracking 0, max 65 characters, for card notes, 11 pt on 15 pt in print. Step 04, Fine print, is Omnes Regular 400 at 24 px on 32 px leading, tracking +0.03 em, 8 pt on 11 pt in print. Optima is never condensed to fit.
brand_identity.voice: Upbeat, plain and welcoming, like a host talking to a regular viewer. Example line the brand would write: "Today on Emberline: a white bean and rosemary gratin you can have on the table in under an hour."

The house colour is recorded twice with two different values, one from the on air graphics package and one from the print kit, with nothing saying which governs, so it must be settled before use.
brand_identity.values: Repeatability and warmth. What the show is actually buying is a look and a written recipe a different editor can run tomorrow, so the brand stays consistent day after day without drift.

palette_rules.distribution: Grounds, panels and fills are Fresh Cream or Ember Coral, solid, and nothing else; every programme card sits on Fresh Cream. On Fresh Cream, titles, segment names and the strap are Warm Charcoal, the show name is Warm Charcoal or Ember Coral as in the bug's wordmark, and the time and card notes are Herb Green, as on emberline_card_template.pdf. On Ember Coral, all type is Fresh Cream, as the segment number reversed out of the disc. On-screen text over footage sits on an Ember Coral strap fill or a Fresh Cream panel, never straight on the picture. Sunlit Butter is a small accent, no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area, never a ground or a line of type.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity, with one exception taken from emberline_card_template.pdf: a Fresh Cream #FBF4E7 pill at 92% opacity may sit behind the Emberline bug where the bug is placed over a photograph or footage, as the bug and its pill sit inside the photo panel on emberline_card_template.pdf. No other tint, transparency, gradient, shadow, glow or blend mode is used, and no translucent scrim, vignette, gradient, tint or shadow of any colour, black and white included, is laid over footage or photographs; solid Ember Coral strap fills and solid Fresh Cream panels carrying type, and the bug with its pill, may sit over them.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the five palette hexes for type, panels, fills, rules, buttons or icons. No Warm Charcoal or other dark ground, panel or fill, which reads moody or corporate, and no gradient, glow or drop shadow on type.
palette_rules.photography: Footage and stills keep their own colour. They may be corrected for white balance and exposure, but are never tinted or recoloured toward the palette, never graded moody, filmic or low-key, and never given hard broadcast punch (heavy sharpening, crushed blacks, oversaturation) that stops the food looking edible. The gratin keeps its own golden crust and white glazed dish.
